incidence_by_funding_decile.definition: deciles assigned within each coin on the same-hour funding_rate; pooled across coins

incidence_by_rv_decile.definition: deciles assigned within each coin on trailing-24h realized volatility; hours without a full trailing window are excluded

interpretation: Descriptive associations on observed liquidation labels. No model was fit, no out-of-sample forecast was evaluated, and no causal or predictive claim is made. The decile tables describe co-incidence in the same panel and must not be read as lead-lag evidence.

label_contract.absence_contract: an hour with liq_count == 0 is an hour with no observed event in the feed; it is not proof that no liquidation occurred

rv_definition: sqrt(sum of squared hourly log close-to-close returns over the trailing 24 closed hours, ending at the prior hour; missing for the first 24 rows of each coin
